title: Weight-space programming on a regulatory-genomics CNN: public release 1
description:
Public release 1 of a preregistered, blinded test of weight-space programming: can an LLM agent detect and repair a planted shortcut in a genomics CNN without data? It contains the code, the preregistration with all 13 amendments, the results and operations log, the preprint (reports/preprint/main.pdf) and redacted analysis outputs.

Answer keys, model weights, run archives and transcripts are withheld, as are the two functions in src/wspg/plant.py that draw the plants, so that the same models can be used in a blinded follow-up (see REDACTIONS.md). A second release is planned after it.
